text:
## Template 11: Account Closure Confirmation  
**Subject:** Your FirstUK Bank Account Is Closed  
```
Dear [Customer Name],

Your FirstUK Bank account has been closed, effective [date].

Final Balance Details:
- Account Number: [ACC-XXXXX]
- Final Balance: £[amount]
- Final Interest: £[amount]
- Fees Applied: £[amount] (if any)
- Net Payout: £[amount]

How You'll Receive Your Balance:
[Selected method: transfer to new bank / cheque / cash at branch]
- Timeframe: [3–5 business days]
- Reference: [Transaction ID]

Important:
- All standing orders and Direct Debits have been canceled
- Your online banking access has been deactivated
- Your card (if issued) is no longer valid

We'll Miss You!
If there's anything we could have done better, please let us know.
Your feedback helps us improve.

If You'd Like to Reopen:
Contact us anytime at 0800-555-2265, and we'll be happy to help.

Thank you for banking with us!

Best regards,
FirstUK Bank Customer Service
```
